coverage: Hanson shots only for categories 0 and 1; category 2 is the rwm_candidates screen on the matched comparison shots, which are unlabelled and not negatives. A shot absent from the table was not examined.

rules.present: the 20 ms before each listed onset, of either mode number (a growth window; see outputs/labeler/rwm/growth.json)
rules.absent: the high-current window (Ip at least half its peak) outside [onset - 100, onset + 100] ms of every listed onset; the precursor before a growth window and the aftermath carry no row (not assessed)
rules.uncertain: rwm_candidates screen spans, comparison shots only
